rationale: All six findings from the final round are resolved, each confirmed by mutation rather than by the shipped assertions alone: reverting replace() to show(), removing clear(), making handleRemove ignore its argument, dropping the render-side link guard, forcing isEnabled true, bypassing apply_override, dropping the enabled filter, and restoring the `$` anchor each make the corresponding test fail. The check round surfaced one genuine build risk of its own — a `javascript:` literal in the new link-safety test violating eslint's no-script-url, which would have failed the CI lint gate — plus prettier drift and a regression test whose assertions hid behind an `if`. All three are fixed, and the render-side guard now matches the server rule exactly. Backend 72 passed across the three customer-config test files; frontend 4977 passed / 1 skipped across 469 files; typecheck clean; eslint clean on the touched files.
